text:
Maya: Quick idea — pop-up Street Food Fair outside the HQ Plaza next Thursday 12:00-2:00? Small vendors, picnic blankets, and a couple of board-game tables for folks who want to hang. Thoughts? :sun_with_face:

Jon: love it. count me in for vendor scouting. any preference on cuisine? tacos pls. :taco:

Devon: I'm on beverage duty if we want non-alcoholic coolers. also can grab the big picnic blankets from storage.

Samira: Yay! Could we do a two-hour staggered lunch sign-up so SRE on-call folks can step away? I can help make a quick sign-up sheet.

Maya: Good call on stagger. @Samira that'd be awesome. can you make a simple slot poll (12:00 / 12:30 / 1:00 / 1:30)?

Samira: done — added a tiny Google Form: https://forms.gle/example (please pick a slot & dietary notes). I'll post results tomorrow.

Priya: dietary note: I'm gluten-free — any GF taco options? Also can we have a quiet corner for people who want to chat without music?

Devon: I'll ask vendors for GF/vegan options. and yea we can reserve the north bench area as a calm zone.

Jon: Volunteer list: me (vendor run), Maya (decor & blankets), Devon (drinks), Priya (signage), Samira (slots + volunteer coord). Anyone else?

Maya: tagging @ParkBot to reserve the outdoor tables and ping facilities for a permit if needed.

ParkBot: facilities request submitted — outdoor table reservation for Thu 11:30-2:30. Permit ETA 24h.

Samira: Heads up — I'll try to keep the sign-up minimal. If you're on-call pls put that in the notes so we can plan a backfill for 15-20 min windows.

Priya: should we set a small company budget for vendor vouchers (e.g., $8/person)? I can run expense if leadership approves.

Maya: I'll ask finance for a micro-budget approval now. cc: @Jon and @Samira for numbers.

Jon: :thumbsup: if you want board games there, drop your top 2 picks in thread. I'll pack them on Thurs morning.

Devon: Codenames, Sushi Go

Samira: Uno, Blokus

Priya: Azul, Love Letter

Maya: Perfect mix — we'll rotate through. Thanks everyone! See poll results tomorrow and I'll post a final plan. :sparkles:
